coverage: Reported business segments · before inter-segment eliminations
incomeDefinition: Each segment’s income: interest earned on loans and investments plus fees and other income, before interest paid to depositors, operating costs and loan-loss provisions. It is not sales. Segments also charge each other, so the rows add up to more than the group’s total income.
definition: Each segment’s profit after provisions (money set aside for possible loan losses) and before tax. The rows add up exactly to group profit before tax of ₹32,293.47 crore. It is not profit after tax.
location: PDF page 11 (consolidated segmental results, year ended 31.03.2026 column) and PDF page 7 (consolidated results, items 1–17); the filing has no printed page numbers
notes: Segment revenue of ₹241,570.28 crore less inter-segment revenue of ₹79,358.33 crore gives group total income of ₹162,211.95 crore. Group profit after tax is ₹26,384.85 crore: profit before tax ₹32,293.47 crore, less tax ₹5,799.65 crore, plus share of an associate ₹54.09 crore, less minority shareholders’ share ₹163.06 crore. Tax is lower by ₹2,193.20 crore (note 11): after regular tax assessment, tax depreciation was allowed on intangibles from the Citi India consumer business, which reversed excess tax provisions of ₹1,129.80 crore, cut current-year tax by ₹265.85 crore and added a deferred tax asset of ₹797.55 crore. Profit was also reduced by two one-time standard-asset provisions: ₹1,231 crore for declassified priority-sector loans (Q2) and ₹2,001 crore of voluntary extra provisioning (Q4). A ₹32.84 crore gratuity charge for the new Labour Codes is also included. Retail Banking includes Digital Banking: segment revenue ₹39,655.73 crore and result ₹4,255.03 crore. This does not show profit for any single account, card or loan product.
insight: Retail banking is the largest source of segment income, while corporate lending and treasury earn more profit per rupee of income. A one-off tax saving and one-off extra loan provisions both moved this year’s profit, so compare the year with care.
